import sys, numpy as np, mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
import rcb_dtb
class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
  self.p=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.qidx=s._jq;self.vidx=s._jv
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv))
 def pose(self):return self.d.xpos[self.p].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.p].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,pos,R,q=None,n=60):
  q=self.s.state()['q'].copy() if q is None else q.copy()
  for _ in range(n):
   self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;self.k.qpos[self.qidx]=q;mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   ep=pos-self.k.xpos[self.p];er=Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.p].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
   if np.linalg.norm(ep)<1e-5 and np.linalg.norm(er)<1e-4:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.p)
   J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,self.vidx[:7]],self.jr[:,self.vidx[:7]]*.3]);e=np.r_[ep,er*.3]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   dq=np.clip(dq,-.12,.12);q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq,self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def move(self,pos,R,hand=None,steps=180):
  p0,R0=self.pose();q=self.s.targets.copy()
  rv=Rotation.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec()
  for i in range(steps):
   t=(i+1)/steps;t=t*t*(3-2*t)
   p=(1-t)*p0+t*pos;rr=Rotation.from_rotvec(t*rv).as_matrix()@R0
   q=self.ik(p,rr,q,n=10)
   if hand is not None:q[7:]=hand
   self.s.step(q)
 def hold(self,steps=60):
  for _ in range(steps):self.s.step(self.s.targets)
 def close(self,hand,steps=120):
  h0=self.s.targets[7:].copy();q=self.s.targets.copy()
  for i in range(steps):
   t=(i+1)/steps;q[7:]=h0*(1-t)+hand*t;self.s.step(q)
 def contacts(self):
  a=[]
  for con in self.d.contact:
   b1=self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom1];b2=self.m.geom_bodyid[con.geom2]
   if self.s._obj in [b1,b2]:
    f=np.zeros(6);mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,self.d,list(self.d.contact).index(con) if False else 0,f)
    a.append((self.m.geom(con.geom1).name,self.m.geom(con.geom2).name,round(con.dist,5)))
  return a

def hand(val=.8,thumb=None):
 h=np.zeros(22)
 h[:5]=[val,0,val,0,val] if thumb is None else thumb
 for ix in [5,9,13,18]:h[ix:ix+4]=[val,0,val,val]
 return h
